principle: HOLD is an engineering/release state, not an instruction to stop artifact generation.
stop_only_on_unsafe: required model binding missing or ambiguous
SolidWorks/adapter compile or runtime failure before any usable artifact exists
fallback_rule: If manufacturing output is requested but release blockers exist, generate an ENGINEERING REVIEW candidate and mark HOLD_RELEASE.
success_rule: If a usable artifact is generated, command returns execution success even when engineering/release state is HOLD.
